frame_clock: floor(frame * fps_den * 100 / fps_num), using integer arithmetic
watermark_rule: ready(k) is the minimum clipped start in declarations[k..], or E when k equals the declaration count; the implicit initial pair is (0, ready(0)); serialized watermarks strictly advance the prefix above 0; render only when FrameClock(frame) < ready(k)
scene_commitment_rule: SHA256(ASCII NCT2-SCENE-DIGEST-v1 || 0x00 || final canonical 80-byte NCT1 header || asset-ID-sorted 52-byte descriptors || exact 128-byte Draws in frozen order)
scene_commitment_properties: asset id, dimensions, and raw length descriptor changes alter commitment
updated verified pixel SHA alters commitment
asset transfer order does not alter commitment
completion_and_terminal_rejections: zero-primitive declaration without an explicit ElementComplete
ElementComplete references an AssetBegin whose bytes or SHA-256 are incomplete
Draw owner/index or clipped interval differs from its declaration
watermark prefix skips a declaration or differs from the reader's contiguous completed prefix
watermark ready is not recomputed from the uncompleted suffix
End followed by one trailing byte or any extra record
valid End while stdin remains open past the no-progress deadline
valid End and EOF with fewer than frame_count sequential output frames
nonzero helper/FFmpeg exit or failed MP4/HLS validation
